title: GoHighLevel Black Friday 2026: 50% Off First 3 Months
description: New HighLevel customers get 50% off the first 3 months on any plan, Nov 23–Dec 6, 2026 (PT). Then regular pricing. Official dates, prices, and how to claim.
html_content:
New HighLevel customers can get 50% off the first 3 months on any plan, from $48.50/mo. The promo started Nov 23, 2026 at 8:00 AM PT and ends Dec 6, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT. After the first three monthly payments, regular plan prices apply.

Get 50% off your first 3 months

What the offer is

HighLevel is running a Black Friday and Cyber Monday promo for new customers: 50% off the first 3 months on any plan. The official page states that the 50% off applies to your first 3 monthly payments. When those three payments are done, the plan returns to its regular monthly price.

There is no public coupon code in the official materials to type in at checkout. HighLevel says coupon codes are applied to each order on its official promo pages. Ignore "SAVE20" or similar codes on coupon-farm sites; those are not this offer.

This page is about the official 2026 promo. For the year-round extended trial (30 days instead of HighLevel's standard 14), see the GoHighLevel 30-day free trial guide. For regular plan features and usage costs, see the GoHighLevel pricing guide.

Dates and deadlines

All official times are Pacific Time.

  • Black Friday Week: Monday, Nov 23, 2026, 8:00 AM PT through Sunday, Nov 29, 2026, 11:59 PM PT. The official HighLevel page says Black Friday Week ends Sunday, November 29, at 11:59 PM PT.
  • Cyber Monday Week: Monday, Nov 30, 2026, 12:00 AM PT through Sunday, Dec 6, 2026, 11:59 PM PT. This is the last window.
  • After Dec 6, 2026, 11:59 PM PT, the promotional prices end and offers revert to standard pricing.

If you are reading this after the promo has ended, the 50% offer is no longer available. Use the 30-day trial guide instead.

Promo prices for new customers

PlanFirst 3 monthsAfter that
$97 plan (Starter)$48.50/mo$97/mo
Unlimited ($297)$148.50/mo$297/mo

HighLevel's 2026 promo materials call the $497 plan the Founder Plan. It adds SaaS Mode, rebilling with markup, the Founders Club, and Partner Network eligibility. Our pricing guide may still describe this same $497 tier as Agency Pro.

How to claim it

  1. Open HighLevel's official promo page during the window (use the button above so the referral is attached).
  2. Choose a plan. The official checkout applies the promotional price to your first 3 monthly payments.
  3. After those three payments, the regular monthly price for that plan applies.

Existing HighLevel customers do not use that new-customer page. Their upgrade offers are inside the app: HighLevel holiday promos.

Get 50% off your first 3 months

If you already have a HighLevel account

The partner brief lists upgrade offers for current customers. These are separate from the new-customer 50% offer:

  • On the $97/mo or $970/yr plan, you can move to Unlimited at $148.50/mo for 3 months, or to the Founder Plan at $248.50/mo for 3 months. Annual options in the brief: Unlimited at $2,673, Founder Plan at $4,473.
  • On Unlimited ($297/mo or $2,970/yr), you can move to the Founder Plan at $297/mo for 3 months, or to the Founder annual at $4,473.
  • On the $497/mo Founder Plan, the annual offer is 12 months for the price of 10, at $4,970. The brief describes the annual 25% as 12 months for the price of 10, plus an additional 10% off (that additional 10% is how the $2,673 and $4,473 figures are reached on the other annual upgrades).
  • Trial customers on any plan get 50% off their current plan for 3 months.

Upgrades reset the billing date and credit unused time from the previous subscription. After the promotional period, pricing reverts to standard.

Add-on bundles

The same brief offers discounts on add-on bundles. Monthly bundle discounts last 3 months. These offers are hidden from trial customers and from customers who already have that add-on.

  • Any 1 add-on: 25% off (annual: 25% off)
  • Any 2 add-ons: 35% off (annual: 37.5% off)
  • Any 3 or more add-ons: 50% off (annual: 50% off)

Listed add-on prices in the brief: HIPAA Compliance $297/mo or $2,970/yr; White Label Mobile App $497/mo or $4,970/yr; Premium Support $500/mo or $5,000/yr.

What this page does not claim

Official materials do not say whether the year-round 30-day extended trial is added on top of this 50% off, or whether the discounted months start after a trial. This page does not claim that they stack. If that matters to you, confirm it on HighLevel's official promo checkout or with HighLevel support before you pay.

A card is required to start a HighLevel trial, including through an affiliate link. HighLevel places a small authorization hold (about $1) to verify the card; that hold is not a plan charge.

Frequently Asked Questions

When does the promo end?

Black Friday Week ends Sunday, Nov 29, 2026, at 11:59 PM PT. Cyber Monday Week is the last chance: Monday, Nov 30, 2026, 12:00 AM PT through Sunday, Dec 6, 2026, 11:59 PM PT. All times are Pacific.

Who is the 50% off for?

The primary offer is for new customers, on any plan, for the first 3 monthly payments. Existing customers have separate in-app upgrade offers. Trial customers on any plan get 50% off their current plan for 3 months.

Is there a coupon code I can paste in?

The official partner brief says coupon codes are applied to each order. It does not publish a public code to copy and paste. Use HighLevel's official promo page during the window.

What do I pay in month 4?

The regular price of the plan you chose: $97, $297, or $497 per month, unless you are on a different billed term that you selected at checkout.

Does this work on annual plans for new customers?

The new-customer table in the official brief is monthly: 50% off the first 3 months, then the regular monthly price. Annual 25% figures in the brief are listed under existing-customer upgrades. This page does not invent a new-customer annual promo price.

Get 50% off your first 3 months

Fine print

All times are Pacific. Offers revert to standard pricing after the promotional period. The 50% off for new customers applies to the first 3 monthly payments. Upgrade offers reset the billing date and credit unused time from the previous subscription. Add-on bundle discounts are hidden from trial customers and from customers who already have that add-on.

This site is an independent HighLevel affiliate. If you buy through the links on this page, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
